scenarios.name: fence-c-plus-plus
scenarios.what: The first reply's fence is tagged c++; the tag is cut and the rest of its line is empty.

scenarios.name: fence-c
scenarios.what: The first reply's fence is tagged c; the tag is cut and the rest of its line is empty.

scenarios.name: fence-cuda
scenarios.what: The first reply's fence is tagged cuda; the cut leaves uda on the first line (a fence-quirk hit), the scripted compile fails, and an untagged correction compiles and runs clean.

scenarios.name: fence-untagged
scenarios.what: The first reply holds prose around one untagged fence; it compiles and runs clean.

scenarios.name: fence-code-on-fence-line
scenarios.what: The first reply's untagged fence has code on its opening line starting with c, so the cut leaves onst on that line (a fence-quirk hit); the scripted compile fails and the correction compiles and runs clean.

scenarios.name: no-fence
scenarios.what: The first reply holds no fence, so the target file is empty; its scripted compile fails at the link and the correction compiles and runs clean.

scenarios.name: several-fences
scenarios.what: The first reply holds a helper in a first cpp fence and the program in a second; only the first is read, its scripted compile fails at the link, and the correction compiles and runs clean.

scenarios.name: compile-error-then-fix
scenarios.what: Attempt 0 fails its scripted compile with a captured EDG error; attempt 1 compiles and runs clean.

scenarios.name: run-error-then-fix
scenarios.what: Attempt 0 compiles and its scripted run dies by signal 11 with stderr; attempt 1 compiles and runs clean.

scenarios.name: stale-output-past-gate
scenarios.what: Attempt 0 compiles and its scripted run exits 3; attempts 1 to 7 fail their compiles; attempt 8 compiles after 8 corrections, past the execution gate, so it is not run and attempt 0's stdout stands.

scenarios.name: crash-past-gate-no-run
scenarios.what: Attempts 0 to 8 fail their compiles; attempt 9 compiles past the execution gate with no earlier run, where the notebook raises and the faithful trial ends upstream-crash.

scenarios.name: baseline-compile-failure
scenarios.what: The target reference fails its scripted compile, so the trial ends before any model call.

scenarios.name: baseline-run-failure
scenarios.what: The target reference compiles and its scripted run exits 1, so the trial ends before any model call.

scenarios.name: spaces-in-source
scenarios.what: Source and reference hold runs of spaces, a tab, and CRLF line ends; the generation prompt cuts the runs, the correction prompt keeps those in the reply's code, and the fix compiles and runs clean.
